deck.title: Types of Programming Language, Translators & Integrated Development Environments (IDEs)

back_blocks.md: A programming language is **a bridge between what humans understand and what a computer understands.**

cards.front_md: What is a **programming language**?
cards.back_md: A programming language is **a bridge between what humans understand and what a computer understands.**

cards.front_md: Define **low-level language.**
cards.back_md: A low-level language is **a programming language that directly translates to machine code** understood by the processor.

back_blocks.md: A translator is a program that **translates program source code into machine code** so that it can be** executed directly** by a processor.

cards.back_md: A compiler is a program that **translates high-level languages into machine code all in one go.**

back_blocks.md: An interpreter is a program that **translates high-level languages into machine code one line at a time.**

cards.front_md: What is an **interpreter**?
cards.back_md: An interpreter is a program that **translates high-level languages into machine code one line at a time.**

front_blocks.md: What are **four main tools/facilities** provided by **IDEs**?

back_blocks.md: The four main tools/facilities provided by IDEs are:

1. **Editor**
2. **Error diagnostics**
3. **Run-time environment**
4. **Translators.**
